leakage_tests.name: as_of_future_mutation
leakage_tests.detail: Changing Historical Forecast values after issue time cannot change features.

leakage_tests.name: exact_lead
leakage_tests.detail: Valid time equals latency-adjusted issue time plus the requested lead.

leakage_tests.name: run_availability
leakage_tests.detail: A run is used only at its preregistered initialization-plus-latency issue time.

leakage_tests.name: complete_window
leakage_tests.detail: A null inside the 168-hour hybrid window makes the feature row unavailable.

leakage_tests.name: unused_run_start_null
leakage_tests.detail: A null outside the selected future segment does not contaminate the window.

leakage_tests.name: used_forecast_null
leakage_tests.detail: A null in the selected run segment is rejected rather than zero-filled.

leakage_tests.name: temporal_partitions
leakage_tests.detail: Training, calibration, and test periods are chronological and disjoint.

leakage_tests.name: forecast_feature_source
leakage_tests.detail: The frozen contract forbids ERA5 in all forecast-time features.

leakage_tests.name: forbidden_pickle
leakage_tests.detail: The evaluation trains a fresh model and never opens the forbidden pickle.

leakage_tests.name: threshold_frozen_before_test
leakage_tests.detail: The 2024-selected threshold was written to the frozen config before 2025 scoring.

leakage_tests.name: episode_partition_isolation
leakage_tests.detail: No district reference episode identifier appears in both 2024 and 2025.

leakage_tests.name: frozen_model_state
leakage_tests.detail: The fitted RandomForest state hash is unchanged from before test scoring.

leakage_tests.name: incident_snapshot_cutoff
leakage_tests.detail: Every available Recall@10 snapshot issue time is at or before local day start minus lead.

claim_scope: A passing lead establishes retrospective rainfall-threshold-event skill under the assumed latency. It does not establish an operational historical forecast or a landslide-warning probability.
